acceptance.revision: Owner-approved replacement: WebGPU CSS parity, no CSS regression for CSS-expressible effects, <16.7 ms p95 for pixel effects CSS cannot render, and CSS fallback above 1080p. See benchmarks/ACCEPTANCE.md.
acceptance.verdict: Simple passes. The heavy 20% gate is not demonstrable because both paths are refresh-locked at 6.2 ms p95; the CSS trace spends ~0.13 ms/frame on paint+raster while the WebGL GPU timer measures 2.94 ms p95. The criterion requires explicit user approval to revise.

fourK.verdict: GPU preview regresses at 4K; the editor now falls back to the CSS preview above a 1080p output budget.
